Unit test passes: every scripted step asserts checkStep [] and checkState(capped) is []; the forged 5th record yields exactly [{bet-cap, 'flop has 5 bets (at most 4)'}]. Mutants killed: checker counting every bet/raise, checker raise exemption removed, checker bet exemption removed, bet exemption without the all-in condition (the last only via the forged-level test). Holdout: checkStep is [] on every step of ~410k fuzz actions, and a forged uncounted record raises no bet-cap. Also confirmed that the raise clause's '=== allInTo' sub-condition can't be reached through legalActions (the mutant setting it to true survives everything); the review already noted it as a guard.

Property test passes (20,000 hands, seed 20261121) and is not vacuous: 6 of my 14 mutants fail it. A gap: it checks that bet/raise is withheld when required and that offered amounts are valid, but not that a raise is offered when the rule requires one. My holdout closes that gap: an independent oracle (level, counts and 'acted since last counted raise' from records only; stacks from starting stacks minus added) compared the full legal set, betCount and currentBet at every step of 40,000 hands over 5 configurations (2-10 seats, heads-up only, odd $5/$10, $3/$6, stacks up to $120), about 411k actions. It also sent about 96k random illegal bet/raise probes (all rejected, state unchanged) and checked chip conservation and round-close consistency. 0 failures out of 2,337,391 checks.

findings.expected_vs_actual: Expected the story doc to say that only the all-in condition inside the checker's raise-size exemption can't be reached through legal play. Actual: it says the raise-clause exemption as a whole is unreachable, but the exemption itself is exercised by every short all-in raise (removing it breaks the suite).
findings.fix: Reword the doc note: the '=== streetContribution + stack' condition within the raise exemption is the unreachable guard.

findings.expected_vs_actual: Expected the property test to also catch a raise wrongly withheld (completeness). Actual: it only checks that bet/raise is absent when forbidden and that offered amounts are valid; a raise missing where it should be offered would pass the property test. The acceptance and unit tests cover the scripted cases.
findings.fix: Optional: also assert that a bet/raise is offered whenever betCount < 4, the seat hasn't acted and stack > owe.
